additional_info.subject: Ticket-System
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens-Team!
We wanted to ask if there is some kind of Ticket-System we could get access to, so we could have all Tickets centralized and don’t need to have so many E-Mails per Ticket.
Our Inbox gets pretty cluttered with the back and forth writing and because of that it gets pretty confusing for us and hard to keep track of which charger and Ticket are at what status.
Per Ticket we have somewhere between 3 and 6 E-Mails, and if there are two tickets open it gets very confusing very fast.
Something like a Jira or something where we can add comments if more information would be needed from your side or something.
Thank you and kind regards
Lara Oblak

additional_info.subject: RE: Ticket-System CRM:02699000244
additional_info.body:
Hi Lara,
Yes, if there are different issues on different chargers , then separate tickets must be created.
However, if the location of multiple chargers is same and all the chargers are facing the same issue then we can create a single ticket.
Moreover, we can use the
Incident report SI E (all products) | MoreApp
for reporting our incident which creating the ticket.
Kindly confirm, if that replies to your query.!
BR,
Shashank Mishra

additional_info.subject: RE: Ticket-System CRM:02699000244
additional_info.body:
Hi Mishra!
We already use the MoreApp Incident report, but our problem is that we have so many tickets opened at the same time and keeping track of them is getting very hard.
Per Ticket we get between 3-5 Mails and it just keeps cluttering our Inbox.
What we actually want to know is if there is any centralized ticket system we could get access to.
Other charging station manufacturers that we work with have a Jira for us, where we can see all tickets we have, add comments and keep track of what is open and what is closed and what belongs to where.
With the E-Mails we get from you we always need to search for all the E-Mail correspondence we had regarding a ticket, before being able to send you information back that you need.
This is burning a lot of time on our side and it would help us a lot if there would be any centralized place we could get access to.
By now we already have 7 chargers from you with more to come and it already gets really chaotic for us, so we would really appreciate anything that could help us.
Thank you and kind regards
Lara Oblak

additional_info.body:
Hello Mr. Knoll!
The chargers belong to the Energie Steiermark Kunden GmbH which is from Energie Steiermark AG.
Just FYI, as I don’t know if it is also relevant:
The Energie Steiermark Technik GmbH got split up into two new GmbHs, one of it is the Energienetze Steiermark.
I’m not entirely sure about the SLA’s for the chargers, though we would only want access to the Portal to be able to keep track of all the open/closed Tickets and what state they are at/add comments if some information from us is needed.
At the moment we are using the More Incident report but this leads to us getting about 3-5 Mails per Ticket and this makes it really hard for us to keep track as we often have multiple tickets opened at the same time. That then leads to longer reply times by us if some information is needed to close the case or further investigation.
We would really appreciate if there is any possibility to have access to something like a Jira or anything.
Thank you for your time and I wish you a nice rest of the week!
Mit freundlichen Grüßen,
Lara Oblak
